answer_value: 9 holes: pair, single, single, pair, pair, single (top to bottom)
steps: Final strip (bottom part) has a pair of holes above a single hole.
Unfolding the second fold reflects them just above the fold: pair near the fold, single farther up.
Unfolding the first (top) fold reflects that group again to the top: single, then pair at the very top.
Top to bottom: pair, single, single, pair, pair, single (9 holes, 3 holes x 3 layers).
A: bottom group has pair below single - fails. B: 8 holes, bottom pair - fails. D: 8 holes, middle groups not symmetric about folds - fails.
C fits. Drawn fold proportions are rough, so some doubt.

answer_value: TL up-arrow, TR square, centre down-arrow, BL circle, BR triangle
steps: Odd steps rotate TL<-centre<-BR<-TL; even steps rotate TR<-centre<-BL<-TR.
F4: TL up, TR circle, C square, BL down, BR triangle; step 4->5 is an even step: TR square, C down, BL circle.
A: circle TL, triangle TR - fails. C: down-arrow TL, up-arrow centre - fails. D: triangle TL - fails.
B fits.
check_code:
F=[dict(TL="sq",TR="dn",C="tri",BL="up",BR="ci"),dict(TL="tri",TR="dn",C="ci",BL="up",BR="sq"),
dict(TL="tri",TR="ci",C="up",BL="dn",BR="sq"),dict(TL="up",TR="ci",C="sq",BL="dn",BR="tri")]
def odd(f): g=dict(f); g["TL"],g["C"],g["BR"]=f["C"],f["BR"],f["TL"]; return g
def even(f): g=dict(f); g["TR"],g["C"],g["BL"]=f["C"],f["BL"],f["TR"]; return g
assert odd(F[0])==F[1] and even(F[1])==F[2] and odd(F[2])==F[3]
n=even(F[3])
opts={"A":dict(TL="ci",TR="tri",C="up",BL="sq",BR="dn"),"B":dict(TL="up",TR="sq",C="dn",BL="ci",BR="tri"),
"C":dict(TL="dn",TR="sq",C="up",BL="ci",BR="tri"),"D":dict(TL="tri",TR="ci",C="dn",BL="sq",BR="up")}
assert [k for k,v in opts.items() if v==n]==["B"]

answer_value: a, m, t, c, v each mirrored, upright, in reversed order
steps: Vertical mirror on right: order becomes a m t c v, each flipped left-right, upright.
A and C: letters not mirrored (normal a, c) - fail.
D: first letter is turned/inverted rather than mirrored a - fails.
B: mirrored a (stem left, bowl right), mirrored m, t with hook left, reversed c, v - fits.

answer_value: figure containing a diagonal / line with arrowheads at both ends
steps: X is a double-headed arrow along the rising (/) diagonal.
A: single head on a falling (\) line - fails. B: single arrowhead only - fails. C: arrows are horizontal/vertical and single-headed - fails.
D: rising diagonal with arrowheads at both ends - fits.

answer_value: TL H, TR D, bottom S
steps: TL of each figure = bottom letter of previous figure (M, K, L), so TL = H.
Bottom letter = TR letter of the figure two back... equivalently previous TR: K, L, H, so bottom = S.
TR is a new letter each time (K, L, H, S all first appearances).
A: TR S repeats - fails. B: TL S - fails. D: TR H repeats - fails.
C: H, D, S - fits.
check_code:
F=[("A","K","M"),("M","L","K"),("K","H","L"),("L","S","H")]
for a,b in zip(F,F[1:]): assert b[0]==a[2] and b[2]==a[1]
seen=set(x for f in F for x in f)
opts={"A":("H","S","S"),"B":("S","D","H"),"C":("H","D","S"),"D":("H","H","S")}
fit=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v[0]==F[-1][2] and v[2]==F[-1][1] and v[1] not in (v[0],v[2]) and v[1] not in [f[1] for f in F]]
assert fit==["C"]
